name: validator-gap-type-rule-when-error-index-is-out-of-range
description: expect.error.index is 5 with 1 event lacking a type: events below min(index, count) are applied.
gap: `applied` is `an index below expect.error.index`; every index of the file is below 5, so event 0 is applied under the literal reading, but the index is itself reported as out of range.
alternatives: vec.json: expect.error.index must be less than the number of events (1)
vec.json: events[0].type must be a string
